# This research repository is not currently public

GeoEpi uses GitHub repositories to document and develop analytical
subprojects. Some repositories remain access restricted while research,
review, data restrictions, partner requirements, or project development are
ongoing.

The repository is listed on the GeoEpi research site to document the
analytical work associated with the project. Public code, data, reports, or
publications will be linked when they are available.

**Research in progress · As open as possible, as restricted as necessary**

[Explore GeoEpi research](pindex.qmd) · [GeoEpi Hub](https://github.com/geoepi/geoepi-hub)
